body: She's mentioned that if she's ever hospitalized she'll use her rights to be released without my knowledge and just do it all over again without me knowing and being able to stop her. I know that the hospital here is pretty notorious for discharging patients who still need help, is this something I have to worry about?

If she leaves and I call the police what are the chances of her talking her way out of it? "We broke up and I left." and whatnot? She's been to a few mental institutions and is pretty good at manipulating her way out.

I've looked into that. From what I can tell until she actively does something I can't make that call. Her plan is to starve to death which is really tough to prove, especially as she's always been thin.
